EmailTemplate.description: Knowledge requestors will receive a confirmation email with their Case details
EmailTemplate.name: PMC_SS_KnowledgeArticleRequestCaseTemplate
EmailTemplate.subject: Mosaic Case #{!Case.CaseNumber}:{!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Case.SuppliedName},
Thank you for submitting your request. Case [Insert Case # and Subject] has been created and our Customer Service Team will review and respond to you soon with an update.
We do our best to reply quickly and appreciate your patience.
Best Regards,
Mosaic Customer Service
